CustomField.description: Used in reporting to avoid yesterday being a weekend
CustomField.formula: CASE( WEEKDAY( Time_Entry_Date__c ), 2, Time_Entry_Date__c - 3, /* Monday -> Show Friday */ 1, Time_Entry_Date__c - 2, /* Sunday -> Show Friday */ 7, Time_Entry_Date__c - 1, /* Saturday -> Show Friday */ Time_Entry_Date__c - 1 /* Default: Yesterday */ )
CustomField.label: Yesterday Business Day
